Three people were booked into the Webb County Jail on Wednesday, October 21, 2026, on alleged federal violations and are being held under U.S. Marshals holds, according to the Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search. An arrest is an allegation, and every person is presumed innocent unless proven guilty.

Hermenegildo Torres-Martinez

Torres-Martinez was arrested Wednesday at 12:15 p.m. on an alleged federal violation. The booking record did not specify a charge class, and no bond amount or case number was listed. He is held under a U.S. Marshals hold through G4S.

Gerardo Hernandez-Angeles

Hernandez-Angeles was arrested Wednesday at 12:15 p.m. on an alleged federal violation. The booking record did not specify a charge class, and no bond amount or case number was listed. He is held under a U.S. Marshals hold.

Luis Fernando Ruiz-Lopez

Ruiz-Lopez was arrested Wednesday at 11:58 a.m. on an alleged federal violation. The booking record did not specify a charge class, and no bond amount or case number was listed. He is held under a U.S. Marshals hold.
